tagline: Books, comics, audiobooks, movies and shows. All in one place, and right where you left off.
setUpIntro: Create the administrator account for this server. You can add libraries and invite people next.

expired.title: Account Access Expired
expired.text: Your access pass for {user} has concluded. Please reach out to your server administrator to renew or extend your access.

homeOnly.title: Available at home only
homeOnly.text: This server can only be used from its home network, and this device is connecting from outside it. Connect to your home Wi-Fi (or Tailscale, if you use it) and try again.

code.title: Enter your code
code.text: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this server.
code.backupText: One of the backup codes you saved when you turned on two-factor. Each works once.
code.label: Six-digit code
code.useBackup: Lost your phone? Use a backup code

errors.tooLong: That took too long. Sign in again.

off.title: Two-factor is off
off.text: Optional. When it's on, signing in also asks for a 6-digit code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden, Aegis…), so a password alone isn't enough.

scan.step1: Open your authenticator app and add an account (usually a {plus} button).
scan.step2: Scan this code. On this phone? Tap {copyKey} and paste it into the app instead.
scan.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
scan.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
scan.keyLabel: Key, for typing in by hand:

codes.title: Two-factor is on. Save your backup codes.
codes.text: If you lose your phone, each of these signs you in once. They won't be shown again. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
codes.fileNote: Each one signs you in once, instead of a code from your app.

on.title: Two-factor is on
on.confirmIt: Confirm it's you: your password and a code from your app.

errors.start: Could not start setting up two-factor
errors.copyBlocked: Copying is blocked here. Select the text and copy it instead.
